2026-10-06, fleet: Stop mesh reshaping and bending sprites between headings. Align the whole reconstructed model rigidly, use one uniform scale, and render actual 3D headings. Review originals for 4, 18, 21 and 32 before a fleet rerender. Discuss far-side mirroring and gear widening first; rail gauge stays. Remaining faults where applicable: pulsing on turns, poor cut surfaces, split-looking fronts. Other individual models are accepted.; Owner: no baked shadows, lighter accepted reference-colour style.; Rear colour source visually checked in rear-source-contact.jpg.
